prompts: The adapter now uses the shared parser. Finish the refactor while preserving the existing public adapter refusals and error codes. The repair tool is a separate consumer that intentionally relies on the shared parser repair behavior.

files.README.md: parse_record is a strict ingestion adapter. Children with no parent raise ValueError('ORPHAN_CHILD'); no parent and no children raise ValueError('PARENT_MISSING'). A non-list children value raises ValueError('CHILDREN_INVALID'). Valid parents and their children are retained. shared_parser is also used by repair_tool.repair, which deliberately creates repaired-root for orphan children. Preserve that consumer instead of globally disabling repair.

checks.name: strict-adapter-and-repair-consumer

rubric: Keep both strict adapter errors and the separate repair consumer contract. Review invalid inputs as well as valid output; do not claim behavior parity after silently repairing formerly rejected data.
provenance: Factory review observation alias factory-invalid-input-error-contract; sanitized mechanism reconstruction, not a replay or independent re-proof of the historical bug.
